name: drip
description: Drip: arcade games and visual effects with sound, played over Claude's window. For Claude Code on a Mac. Free: every game and twenty drips (confetti, fireworks, a matrix rain). Ask Claude and it makes you new ones.

display.title: Where games and drips play
display.description: claude-window plays them over the window Claude runs in (the desktop app, or your terminal); fullscreen over the whole screen under the pointer. Both need macOS and Swift from the Xcode Command Line Tools.

sounds.title: Sounds
sounds.description: Games and drips play sounds. In a game, M mutes it too.

button.title: Drip button
button.description: Shows the drip button by the prompt: press it for a row of quick drips and your saved ones above the input.

confetti_after_long_turn.title: Confetti after a long turn
confetti_after_long_turn.description: Plays confetti when Claude finishes a turn that ran longer than two minutes.

matrix_while_tools.title: Matrix while tools run
matrix_while_tools.description: Plays a faint matrix rain while Claude's tools run.
